purpose: Tail recalibration of the stacked prediction. On the LOMO / fair months the v35 stack is compressed: it over-predicts rows it puts at 300-600 s (-12 ... -25 s) and under-predicts rows it puts above 1,800 s in every month (2,400-3,600 s: untracked +109 / +257 / +287 / +151 s, tracked +47 / +282 / +141 / +95 s), as expected when calibrated components are averaged. The candidates stretch the upper tail, value + k x max(value - t, 0), with k FITTED by least squares on the other recipe months (never chosen by hand), separately for untracked and tracked non-LIRF rows. No model is fitted beyond that one coefficient per scope.

prior_context.note: Declared AFTER an exploratory leave-one-month-out read on these same four months with the v35 stack as control (disclosed): t = 1200 / 1500 / 1800 / 2400 gave mean -0.157 / -0.188 / -0.185 / -0.124%, every month better for every t; a linear per-scope recalibration -0.159%. LIRF was left out after its in-sample slopes proved unstable (0.95-1.29). The v36 control variant and the exclusion of observation-anchored rows were not read before this declaration.
prior_context.ranking_exposure_label_free: v35 has 4,067 rows at 2,400-3,600 s and 780 at 3,600-7,200 s (development: about 1,100 and 160 a month)

controls.v35: tools/run_mix_gate.stack (v34 weights -> u300 -> callsign 50% -> queue trust 0.75 regular); must reproduce docs/disagreement/mix_gate_v1_results.json's control_rmse on November / December to 1e-6 s
controls.v36: tools/run_higher_bundle.layered with configs/higher_bundle_v2.json's mu_pc_pcc (v35 stack on the mu600 mix + peer-congestion lifts); must reproduce higher_bundle_v2_results.json's mu_pc_pcc RMSE on every month to 1e-6 s

scopes: untracked = non-LIRF rows with matched false; tracked = non-LIRF rows with matched true; rows moved by the callsign fix or queue trust (observation-anchored) and all LIRF rows keep the control
fit: for each held month, k_scope = sum(x * r) / sum(x^2) over the OTHER three recipe months' in-scope rows, x = max(control - t, 0), r = label - control (control = the same variant's values); for the ranking export, k from all four months
candidate_semantics: value = max(control + k_scope x max(control - t, 0), floor) on in-scope rows; every other row keeps its control value; each candidate is compared with ITS OWN control variant
selection: Unchanged rule, per control variant, over the four recipe months: eligible when no recipe month is worse on ALL rows, the mean ratio is at least 0.02% below 1, and every touched month's paired-day 95% interval (seed 20260928) lies below zero; lowest mean ratio among eligible within the variant. The v36 variant is informative only while v36 is unscored; the variant matching the incumbent at ship time is the one that ships.
ship: delta on the ranking rows = k_scope (four-month fit) x max(incumbent float - t, 0) on in-scope rows, added to the incumbent's rebuilt floats (tools/export_stack.py), floor -12 s; independent check; audit; upload only on the user's decision.
